# Handed the turn, this side offers what is queued for the partner: one is
# wanted, one isn't, and a killed one isn't offered at all.  A message is
# forwarded once the partner prompts after it, and the next is offered once
# the partner prompts after its NO.
@queued SP Q1TEST @ Q2BBS.GBR.EURO < Q9TEST $5_Q1BBS
@queued SB ALL @ GBR < Q9TEST
@queued SP Q3TEST @ Q2BBS < Q9TEST
@killed 3
@answering [FBB-7.0-ABFHM$]
< de Q1BBS>
> F>
< SP Q1TEST @ Q2BBS.GBR.EURO < Q9TEST $5_Q1BBS
> OK
< Title 1
< R:261031/1200Z @:Q1BBS.#77.GBR.EURO
< Body 1.
< /EX
@check accepted=0 forwarded=0 refused=0 pending=3
> Q2BBS>
< SB ALL @ GBR < Q9TEST $2_Q1BBS
> NO
> Q2BBS>
< *** DONE
< *** disconnected
@check accepted=0 forwarded=1 refused=1 pending=1
